instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show how each of this person's published posts did in each place it went: that place's own counts, the visitors its link brought and what they bought", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:see-how-each-post-did and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give observations (each place's own counts for a post, read with that place's tools: { post_id, account_id, metrics: { name: number }, observed_at } or { platform_post_id, account_id?, metrics }), visits and conversions (as tool:break-down-visits-and-sales takes them: { visitor, project?, signals: { utm_content, ...
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: post (records:list).
